{{Quote|According to this log, Operations Group One set out to free the Sith. Group Two stayed behind to secure their escape. Then they were attacked.|Commander Calum|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Special Operations Group One''', also known as '''Operations Group One''', was one of five Special Operations groups sent by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] into the [[Belsavis prison]] during the [[Invasion of Belsavis]] during the [[Galactic War]] in hopes of locating and freeing the [[Dread Masters]].<ref name="The Dread Masters" /> Led by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Andreaus Thos]],<ref name="A Thousand Pardons" /> Operations Group One was successful in breaching the section of the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] known as [[the Tomb]] with the aid of [[Special Operations Group Two]], and Group Two established a [[Imperial remote post|base camp]] while Group One continued into the Tomb&mdash;but the Imperials unleashed the savage [[Esh-kha]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from their stasis, and suffered heavy losses. Part of Group One located the Dread Masters in [[Vault 914]] but were killed by the Esh-kha,<ref name="The Dread Masters" /> and Thos led another part of the group to [[stasis block 44]] to free other [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] prisoners, but his forces suffered heavy losses at the hands of the Republic.<ref name="A Thousand Pardons" />
